title: Practice 3: To whom: giving, telling, showing

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Судебный пристав взял всю пачку и передал ___ (председатель).
exercises.why: Just as the subject of a verb is in the nominative case, and the object of the verb is in the accusative case, there can be an *indirect* object of the verb that goes in the *dative* case. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 28, 39.  ·  «The dative case is used mostly to denote the person to whom something is given, sent, told, shown, etc.» — DLI, Lesson 28.
exercises.context: Just as the subject of a verb is in the nominative case, and the object of the verb is in the accusative case, there can be an *indirect* object of the verb that goes in the *dative* case.
